component.name: FrostPill
component.script:
sub init() m.th = LumenTheme() m.body = m.top.createChild("Group") m.ringPill = m.body.createChild("Poster") m.ringPill.uri = "pkg:/images/ui/pill_64.9.png" m.ringPill.translation = [-5, -5] m.ringPill.height = 74 m.ringPill.blendColor = m.th.white m.ringPill.visible = false m.fill = m.body.createChild("Poster") m.fill.uri = "pkg:/images/ui/pill_64.9.png" m.fill.height = 64 m.stroke = m.body.createChild("Poster") m.stroke.uri = "pkg:/images/ui/pill_64_stroke.9.png" m.stroke.height = 64 m.glass = m.body.createChild("Poster") m.glass.uri = "pkg:/images/ui/glass_pill_64.9.png" m.glass.height = 64 m.glass.visible = false m.mark = m.body.createChild("Poster") m.mark.width = 30 m.mark.height = 30 m.label = m.body.createChild("Label") m.label.font = LumenFont("Manrope-Bold", 24) m.label.height = 64 m.label.vertAlign = "center" layout() end sub
sub layout() yellow = (m.top.style = "yellow") if yellow m.label.font = LumenFont("Manrope-ExtraBold", 24) m.mark.width = 48 m.mark.height = 48 end if m.mark.uri = m.top.glyph m.mark.visible = (m.top.glyph <> "") m.label.text = m.top.text if m.top.round or m.top.text = "" w = 64 m.mark.translation = [(64 - m.mark.width) / 2, (64 - m.mark.height) / 2] m.label.visible = false else m.label.visible = true m.label.width = 0 tw = m.label.boundingRect().width if tw <= 0 then tw = Len(m.top.text) * 14 m.label.width = tw + 2 if yellow ' Spec 6.3: 8 inset, 48 mark, 12 gap, label, 26 right padding. m.mark.translation = [8, 8] m.label.translation = [68, 0] w = 68 + tw + 26 else ' Spec 6.6: 20 left, 30 glyph, 12 gap, label, 24 right. x = 20 if m.mark.visible m.mark.translation = [20, 17] x = 62 end if m.label.translation = [x, 0] w = x + tw + 24 end if end if m.fill.width = w m.stroke.width = w m.glass.width = w m.ringPill.width = w + 10 m.top.width = w m.body.scaleRotateCenter = [w / 2, 32] paint() end sub
sub paint() if m.fill = invalid then return f = m.top.focused ' style="yellow" (Ask Zeus) keeps its yellow Zeus mark as the only accent. accent = (m.top.style = "yellow") m.ringPill.visible = false m.glass.visible = true if f ' Focus: white liquid glass with ink text (yellow is reserved for accents). m.fill.blendColor = m.th.white m.fill.opacity = m.th.focusOpacity m.stroke.visible = false m.glass.opacity = 1 m.label.color = m.th.ink if accent then m.mark.blendColor = m.th.white else m.mark.blendColor = m.th.ink m.body.scale = [1.04, 1.04] else m.fill.blendColor = m.top.deep if m.top.solid then m.fill.opacity = 0.82 else m.fill.opacity = m.th.frostOpacity m.stroke.visible = true m.glass.opacity = 0.55 m.label.color = m.th.white m.mark.blendColor = m.th.white m.body.scale = [1, 1] end if end sub
